title: Dexcom G6 data collection fails after a week
symptom: Dexcom G6 transmitter serial starts with 81, used for about 6 months. Sensors with xDrip cannot be used for more than a week; after a week, BG readings become noisy and stop with sensor errors. Using Dexcom patched apps works fine for more than 10 days.
evidence_quote: I have never been able to use sensors with Xdrip for more than a week. After a week, the BG readings starts being very noisy and it stops (sensor errors).
